{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for commas in revenue
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"Number of revenue values with commas: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Check if any revenue values are exactly '999999.99' (QA orders)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check if any revenue values are '0.00' or '0' — these are real orders
print(df['revenue'].value_counts().head(5))"}
